_doc: doc 05 §1 adoption rule. Toy model: parameters = a constant recall probability p; trainer fits p = recall rate of the training reviews. 500 reviews -> oldest 400 train, newest 100 holdout. Holdout log-loss: current p=.5 -> ln 2 = .693147; candidate p=.9 -> -(.9 ln .9 + .1 ln .1) = .325083, a 53% improvement >= 1% -> adopt.
